author: Widogeist
body: Labrys was pretty cool in its time, but many other good 2h weapons came out since then (celestial weapons, ymir brilliant feathers, yelmogus weapons, etc). Labrys may still be good for certain builds that revolve around collat, but your weapon is only 179% so it's not the greatest. Most players would likely fill the axe up with ferocious bull eye adorns + 1 ashen ruby, and use it for 100% crit builds with either realm strikes 2 or rend daggers; honestly though, you'd be better off using a celestial weapon with prometheus hands for that type of build.
